title: Isolation of Klebsiella Strains from Water Samples
author: MedVetKlebs consortium
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baxuifnw

steps.title: Collect and pool water samples
steps.instruction: Collect water in 5 L sterile containers, six containers per site (total 30 L), transport them to the laboratory, pool the samples and process them with the CapE system by placing the submersible pump into the pooled water. (Note: these first two steps may vary with partner equipment.)

substeps.instruction: Collect water in 5 L sterile containers.
Collect six containers per site (30 L total).
Pool the samples and process with the CapE system using a submersible pump.

steps.title: Incubate filters in BPW
steps.instruction: Fold each 0.45 μm filter with sterile forceps, place all filters from a 30 L sample into a single 100 mL Buffered Peptone Water (BPW) tube, and incubate for 18–24 h at 42 °C ± 1 °C.

steps.title: Streak onto SCAI medium
steps.instruction: Using a 10 μL loop, streak the BPW enrichment onto a 90 mm petri dish containing SCAI medium, then incubate at 37 °C ± 1 °C for 48 h ± 1 h (colonies may be visible after 24 h). If the medium turns completely yellow due to many inositol‑fermenting colonies, consider diluting before streaking.

steps.title: Subculture suspect Klebsiella colonies
steps.instruction: Select typical yellow, moist, dome‑shaped Klebsiella‑like colonies on SCAI, streak them onto a non‑selective agar (e.g., LB or TSA) to obtain isolated colonies, and incubate at 37 °C ± 1 °C for 24 h ± 1 h. If colonies are numerous and close together, re‑isolate the colony on a fresh SCAI plate first and incubate up to 48 h for purity.

steps.title: Identify species of isolates
steps.instruction: Determine the species of purified suspect K. pneumoniae colonies using MALDI‑TOF mass spectrometry and/or species‑specific PCR.

steps.title: Optional: Freeze remaining plate material
steps.instruction: After picking selected colonies, sweep the remaining SCAI plate content into CryoBank tubes (or equivalent BHI + 15 % glycerol medium) and store at –80 °C for mixed‑colonies sequencing if desired.

steps.title: Freeze confirmed Klebsiella isolates
steps.instruction: Freeze strains confirmed as Klebsiella pneumoniae (or related species) at –80 °C using CryoBank tubes or equivalent (e.g., BHI + 15 % glycerol medium). If several morphotypes are present, store one colony per morphotype.
